purpose: Qualify transfer-oriented promotion and actual neural trial values on complete two-round matched own-data journals and independent final families, without changing budgets or success thresholds.

pilot.evaluation: Development only, including engineering transfer outcomes; never final confirmation inference. Weights, proofs and experiences do not initialize main.

common: One maintained uniform question-selection producer per final seed starts from the exact fresh materialized initial lower model/Adam and the same seven own checked prerequisites. Before any optimizer update it acquires both rounds of48 own queries. Every arm receives exact per-round query/source/evidence/replay/anchor snapshots; later method-dependent model, Adam, RNG and feedback remain its own. Corpus availability is identical; declared rehearsal/focus/objective choices may select and weight that corpus differently. Full acquisition cost is charged to EVERY arm ceiling and physically incurred once. No arm acquires a different second-round dataset. Random-balanced and adaptive-balanced now receive the same full source data and identical balanced method; their retained weight/Adam checkpoints must be byte-identical as an engineering positive control. They are not additional independent evidence.
task_owner: The actual source producer uses maintained Frontier::refresh/candidates/choose, ordinary formal prefilter and independent native search/admission. Uniform selection makes timing feedback unable to alter the fixed source journal. Branches replay the immutable original owned records; actual resource costs remain measured and charged. This component comparison does not measure the production adaptive question selector.
knowledge_control: Per-seed common definitions and theorem dictionary stay fixed in all arms; new own checked discoveries affect task proposals and replay. This isolates preparation and method composition on common sources from dictionary growth; it is not the full production knowledge-growth policy.

limits.stop_boundary: Before next indivisible existing search/training/evaluation unit; last unit overrun is measured and reported, incomplete candidate never selected
limits.learning_rate: Controlled methods use .001 or .0005 within the same250 steps; fixed balanced/reference controls retain .001.

resource_policy: Existing 768 MiB work lease, 48 MiB replay graph pool, 32 KiB persistent State, native graph/context/fact/depth/action caps and per-job IO limits remain. Equal ceilings do not imply equal actual compute. Common search and bank construction costs are reported separately; arm CPU includes selection, checking, preparation, training, qualification, serialization and IO bookkeeping. The common implementation uses canonical hex for bounded theorem snapshots, small references to the original owned trace journal, and detached inference inputs. The inference routing preserves model/Adam bytes but may change near-tied float32 rankings; every arm and initial/selected control uses the same frozen routing. Before branching, outer contexts and all adaptive final arms use the same canonical replay eviction to reserve2.5KiB for bounded upper-state metadata inside the original32KiB State cap. This makes their first lower replay inputs identical even though only the learned arm consumes the upper model. Both balanced controls now receive the same full source corpus and metadata reserve; their byte-identical retained lower checkpoint is an engineering control, not independent evidence. All arms expose the same complete owned source union; phase rehearsal controls use, not ownership availability. Exact retained artifact chunks spill to local evidence storage between arms and are restored one arm at a time after all training; checkpoints/Adam bytes are unchanged. Whole-harness peak RSS is sampled and must remain inside the existing768MiB work reservation; no OS hard RSS limit is claimed.
qualification: All120 original development questions, the32 original individual sentinels and earlier anchors remain mandatory. Promotion additionally requires complete outcomes for24 new transfer questions in12 whole held-out families, positive equally family-weighted transfer gain, and no negative whole-family transfer delta. Exact incumbent weights AND Adam remain on rejection. Extra bounded transfer searches execute inside the same150-unit/CPU/wall/IO/memory allowance and all measured costs are charged.
confirmation: Both complete own-data rounds for every final seed are fixed before the first optimizer call. All48 outer trials and all21 final two-round learning arms finish before any final inference. New48 final questions in24 whole construction families exclude all earlier learning/development/confirmation and new transfer roots/families before variants. Native cores retain the same three extra composition steps and10/16/14/8 operation distribution. Previous finals are retired diagnostics.

primary.success: Mean gain at least 5 percentage points, no negative seed, paired family-bootstrap 95 percent lower bound greater than zero

bootstrap.groups: 24 whole construction families paired across arms and seeds

secondary: current preparation versus adaptive balanced replay
selected versus exact own initial weights
family/operation regressions and actual CPU/wall/IO costs
retained and candidate updates plus checked replay/source coverage
interpretation: Source-grammar coverage is limited and syntax capability estimates are hypotheses, not universal mathematical difficulty. A positive finite matched result would not establish unbounded autonomous improvement, new calculus completeness, durable multi-round capacity growth, or physical deployment. Negative and incomplete results remain part of the evidence. Development and exact-ID operating checks are distinct from the fresh family confirmation. The common helper recipes condition this study; the new task grammar is not an external mathematics benchmark. All three lower initialization seeds repeat the prior meta study; seed 2411 explicitly retests its earlier regression. Fresh confirmation families, rather than new initialization seeds, provide the new held-out comparison. These are three fixed initializations, not a seed-population confidence interval. Prior held-out diagnostics and exact-replay engineering controls do not qualify new independent performance. Upper-model context transfer is measured on three fixed new lower contexts, not a distribution-free meta-learning theorem. Actual next-plan execution and recovery are separate operating evidence. A negative or inconclusive result is retained without tuning the revealed final questions.

preparation_control.reference: Test-only reference sampler exactly reconstructed from scientific source 9c10e29a; frozen incumbent priorities, family/rule/state weighting, replay only. Never compiled into an ordinary provider.
preparation_control.targeted: Current candidate scores refreshed every existing ten-update unit, success-probability priorities bounded to 1..8 inside fixed origin/family/proof/rule strata; three complete cyclic decision cycles then one focused cycle. Existing checked own/peer anchors rehearsed from their original owned source, deduplicated by job and within the same State/pool/source-byte limits.
preparation_control.balanced: Unchanged prior hierarchical cyclic replay-only comparator.
preparation_control.forensics: All prior confirmation outcomes are retired diagnostic evidence. No diagnostic path or proof extracted from them may enter training or the new confirmation.

preparation_success.success: Mean gain at least 5 percentage points, no negative seed, paired family-bootstrap 95 percent lower bound greater than zero. Additional to the unchanged overall primary condition; no threshold relaxation.
preparation_success.qualification: Direct preparation criterion remains separately assessed; do not call meta loss decrease, activity, a good single seed or neural mechanism tests a quality gain.

outer_meta_learning.lower_trial: Actual fresh lower weights/Adam and identical original own source pool within each context; every trial executes the original250 candidate updates and all original150 units plus bounded transfer calls within those units. Only actual upper weights/Adam and observed past profiles/memory carry forward.
outer_meta_learning.context_partition: Novel acquisition dependency SHA-256 byte0 modulo3 roles0/1 outer training, role2 final; the seven shared declared prerequisites are excluded from novel acquisition counts. All final lower initializations are held out from outer training.
outer_meta_learning.pilot: Seed3607 one context, two real trials; development only. Pilot weights/experiences never initialize main.
outer_meta_learning.source_capacity: Before fixing each common lower pool, reserve the bounded2.5KiB lossless upper-state metadata plus a prospective full development-profile encoding envelope inside the original32KiB State. All six own-source contexts qualify the unchanged minimum8-example/3-family pool before the first actual trial. The envelope derives only syntax cells, maximum serialized counters/cost and coverage; no hypothetical outcome is observed ability. Each trial uses identical fixed lower sources. Validate the actual reconstructed base before any optimizer update. The previous meta study's first two incomplete main attempts remain preserved in its earlier delivery: omitted profile growth and then insufficient8-source capacity. No final inference occurred; no question, quality threshold, method, memory count or native resource cap changes.

neural_meta_model.architecture: 59 inputs (32 quantized observed context features plus 27 ordered method-composition features), 12 tanh hidden units, three learned heads: checked family-balanced transfer gain, transfer-family/protected/anchor forgetting risk, measured lower CPU. Adam .003, eight bounded updates on each actual completed trial, replay up to four whole owned experiences. Binary paired weights/Adam in the existing job artifact owner. The same four complete experiences use lossless typed tuples and canonical phase bits in bounded working State; full named experiences remain in their original owned trial records. No field is discarded.
neural_meta_model.context: Only observed abilities, source structure/origin/size, current retained lower progress, past regressions and past costs; no new trial result, question IDs, seed IDs or truth labels enter prediction inputs.
neural_meta_model.plan_grammar: Three ordered phases of8/9/8 existing lower units; each selects balanced/current-focused data, original replay versus owned-anchor rehearsal, checked successful-action marginal versus up to half pairwise search preference, and LR .001/.0005. 24^3 compositions, not a fixed whole-strategy table.
neural_meta_model.policy: 16 bounded proposals (three fixed anchors and13 generated compositions); neural predicted gain minus predicted forgetting minus .05 predicted normalized lower CPU;20 percent uniform exploration (cold start explores), including untried or previously unsuccessful compositions. Mathematical admission and original resources remain external.
neural_meta_model.costs: Whole-process and per-unit CPU/wall are measured. Lower and meta selection/optimization costs remain separate. Outer trial/common acquisition cost is fully reported and charged to the learned system; equal final lower ceilings are not equal lifetime compute. The regression target is the exact persisted lower CPU/wall through unit149, so restarting a partial final paired write cannot invent a different experience. Final gate and meta CPU/wall remain included in Progress and full process/trial totals. Transfer qualification cost is included in the unchanged lower CPU/wall target and whole-unit accounting.

meta_success.success: For every direct comparison, the same original requirement: mean gain at least5pp, no negative seed, paired24-family bootstrap95percent lower bound strictly positive. Full system success additionally requires the unchanged original primary criterion; added controls do not replace it.

transfer.operations: Three whole roots in each of the four maintained bounded native operation recipes; same three extra core composition steps as final. Question-only native construction, no teacher proof or outcome in generation.
transfer.split: Transfer and final roots are excluded from all lower training/acquisition, including renamed variants and owned continuations. Transfer outcomes are model-selection and upper-training labels; independent final outcomes are never labels. The fixed transfer panel is shared by the outer rewards and final lower gates, so this does not establish meta transfer to previously unseen reward panels.
transfer.promotion: Original positive development gain and all old protected/anchor gates, AND positive family-balanced transfer gain and no family net regression.
transfer.meta_targets: Actual retained transfer mean delta, zero for a rejected candidate; separate actual fraction of transfer families with negative candidate delta, raised to one for any protected/anchor loss; actual persisted lower CPU. Old development before/after remains in owned records but is not a substitute meta gain target. A positive unretained candidate is never counted as a retained gain.
transfer.persistence: All24 paired native search outcomes and observed coverage survive original record binding and lossless compact working memory. Incomplete/noncanonical coverage cannot qualify. Future transfer outcomes never enter prediction features.
